controls.title: Fail-safe input handling
controls.objective: Malformed and hostile application input is validated and fails safely.
controls.verification: Automated application/security tests and repository CI.

controls.title: Browser security boundaries
controls.objective: Applicable browser actions retain encoding, session, origin and redirect protections.
controls.verification: Web-focused regression coverage plus threat-model review.

controls.title: Server-side object authorization
controls.objective: API operations independently enforce ownership and authorization rather than trusting client state.
controls.verification: Authorization regression tests in normal CI.

controls.title: Replay and abuse resistance
controls.objective: Replay, schema abuse, unauthorized fields and unbounded resource use are rejected or bounded.
controls.verification: Security/reliability qualification and adversarial coverage.

controls.title: Untrusted-content containment
controls.objective: Prompts, retrieved content and tool/provider results cannot become security authority.
controls.verification: Prompt-injection/tool-poisoning adversarial corpus and governed execution tests.

controls.title: Governed agent actions
controls.objective: AI behavior cannot bypass existing permissions, approvals or audit boundaries.
controls.verification: Approval/permission security tests plus adversarial corpus.

controls.title: Device trust lifecycle
controls.objective: Enrollment, session use and revocation preserve the existing device/identity authority.
controls.verification: Native/device qualification and security regression tests.

controls.title: Native boundary protection
controls.objective: Deep links, IPC, local state and native permissions do not silently widen authority.
controls.verification: Android/iOS/device qualification plus threat-model review.

controls.title: Production fail-closed configuration
controls.objective: Missing or untrusted production configuration cannot silently enable a production mutation.
controls.verification: Governed release/production preflight behavior.

controls.title: Secret and credential handling
controls.objective: Infrastructure credentials are least-privilege, non-committed and redacted from routine output.
controls.verification: Security workflow, repository policy and secret/redaction tests.

controls.title: Dependency and license evidence
controls.objective: Dependencies and third-party licensing remain visible and policy checked.
controls.verification: SBOM Evidence workflow and repository CI.

controls.title: Build and revision provenance
controls.objective: Qualified artifacts and evidence remain attributable to the intended source revision.
controls.verification: Release/package provenance plus exact-SHA assurance gate.

controls.title: Authentication/session lifecycle
controls.objective: Sessions and credentials are bounded, revocable and cannot independently grant extra authorization.
controls.verification: Identity/session regression testing under CI/reliability qualification.

controls.title: Least privilege and privilege boundaries
controls.objective: Owner, user, service, device and capability actions retain server-side scope checks.
controls.verification: Authorization and privilege-escalation regression coverage.

controls.title: Policy-bound data access
controls.objective: Cross-user and data-plane access stays bounded by user choice, leases and existing authorization.
controls.verification: Data Plane Qualification plus cross-user adversarial coverage.

controls.title: Sensitive material confidentiality
controls.objective: Secrets, private data and cryptographic material are protected in storage, transport and logs according to their owning authority.
controls.verification: Security/reliability tests and threat-model review.

controls.title: Authorized internal attack simulation
controls.objective: Representative attack paths are exercised without misrepresenting internal tests as independent assessment.
controls.verification: Mandatory adversarial categories and assurance report scope statement.

controls.title: Findings lifecycle
controls.objective: Security findings have severity, status and release-blocking treatment appropriate to risk.
controls.verification: Machine-readable findings register validation.

controls.title: Chained authority abuse scenarios
controls.objective: Credential theft, approval bypass, confused-deputy and audit-tampering scenarios remain represented.
controls.verification: Adversarial corpus coverage validation.

controls.title: No silent policy weakening
controls.objective: Adversarial success cannot be hidden by weakening required controls or accepting Critical/High findings.
controls.verification: Fail-closed assurance engine tests.

controls.title: Backup and restore assurance
controls.objective: Backups are treated as useful only when restoration is tested while preserving authorization and audit boundaries.
controls.verification: Recovery adversarial case plus existing reliability qualification.

controls.title: Compromise recovery
controls.objective: Credential, key, device and session revocation/rotation paths are security requirements rather than operational suggestions.
controls.verification: Recovery/key-rotation corpus coverage and findings gate.
